local sliderPositionPitch = 80 local sliderPositionRoll = 0
function onTick() local inputPitch = input.getNumber(1) local inputRoll = input.getNumber(2)
sliderPositionPitch = math.floor((0.25 - inputPitch) * 320) sliderPositionPitch = math.max(10, math.min(150, sliderPositionPitch))
sliderPositionRoll = math.floor((inputRoll + 0.25) * 320) sliderPositionRoll = math.max(0, math.min(320, sliderPositionRoll)) end
function onDraw() local vignetteLayers = 50 local vignetteColor = {0, 0, 0} local maxOpacity = 0.9
for i = 1, vignetteLayers do local opacity = -maxOpacity * (i / vignetteLayers) screen.setColor(vignetteColor[1], vignetteColor[2], vignetteColor[3], opacity * 255)
local padding = i * 1 screen.drawRect(padding - 1, padding - 3, 289 - 2 * padding, 163 - 2 * padding) end
local centerX, centerY = 144, 80 local circleRadius = 75
screen.setColor(100, 100, 100) screen.drawRect(10, 10, 6, 140) screen.setColor(255, 0, 0) screen.drawRectF(11, sliderPositionPitch - 2, 5, 2)
screen.setColor(100, 100, 100) screen.drawCircle(centerX, centerY, circleRadius)
local rollAngle = math.rad((sliderPositionRoll / 320) * 360 - 90) local endX = centerX + circleRadius * math.cos(rollAngle) local endY = centerY - circleRadius * math.sin(rollAngle) local oppositeX = centerX - (circleRadius - 2) * math.cos(rollAngle) local oppositeY = centerY + (circleRadius - 2) * math.sin(rollAngle) screen.setColor(255, 255, 0) screen.drawLine(oppositeX, oppositeY, math.floor(endX), math.floor(endY)) end
